title: HIV infection screening in pregnant persons

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians screen for HIV infection in all pregnant persons, including those who present in labor or at delivery whose HIV status is unknown.

action: Screen for HIV infection in all pregnant persons, including those presenting in labor or at delivery with unknown HIV status.

derived.window: text gives no timing; screening during the current pregnancy is approximated as any HIV test within the measurement year
